data.name: King's Angel: Otome
data.detailed_description:
King's Angel: Otome is a visual novel set in a medieval fantasy world of magic, angels and demons.

Features

  • Interactive story with hundreds of conversation choices

  • Female protagonist

  • Two male love interests: Calix and Madion

  • A looping world - replay scenes in the story to make different choices and reach a different outcome

  • Multiple endings

Plot

Recently named the king's personal bard, you wake up on the palace floor. The kingdom has been reduced to ruin by a magical force, making nearly all of its residents disappear.

You meet several others who still cling to life - Calix, the guardian angel gone astray, Madion, the jester who resents and hounds you, Edwina the shady alchemist... Most of these individuals struggle with memory loss, but still, they are hiding secrets.

You soon discover that the magical curse makes the world reset and loop - but you can change what happens in every reincarnation.

Discover what happened to the kingdom, find love, work your way out of the curse, and choose your ending!

---

"King's Angel: Otome" is a reimagining of the visual novel "Jester / King" by the same writer, this time with a female protagonist who is a bard. Her and Madion's stories will be new, while the tale will still take place in the cursed kingdom of Quilissia after the king's death.
